note: Child-facing words for Cargo Commander (EC). `copy` has the shape of the screen's CargoCopySchema (minigames/cargo/copy.ts); `misconceptions` and `helpLabels` are read by content/minigames.ts. Placeholders are the givens only; {answer} appears only in the SHOW ME hints.

briefs.exactLoad: The elevator needs exactly {target} kg. Load crates that make a TOTAL of {target} kg.
briefs.capacityRemaining: The freight holds {capacity} kg. {loaded} kg is aboard. Fill the REMAINING space with sacks and boxes.
briefs.missingAmount: The order is {order} kg. {have} kg is aboard. Add the MISSING kilograms.
briefs.twoDeliveries: Two orders go up together: {a} kg and {b} kg. Load the TOTAL.
briefs.compare: This pallet has {light} kg. The other pallet has {heavy} kg. Add MORE to make them the SAME.
briefs.twoStep: The freight holds {capacity} kg. Two orders are aboard: {a} kg and {b} kg. Fill the REMAINING space.

cues.start: Load the freight, then press WEIGH.
cues.weighing: The scale is weighing the load.
cues.notRight: Not that load. Look at the job again.
cues.delivered: Delivered. The next order is ready when you are.
cues.allDone: Every delivery is made. Fine loading, Commander!
cues.fresh: Here is a new load to try.
cues.trouble: The scale did not answer. Press WEIGH again.
cues.unsupported: This load cannot be shown here. Go back to the elevator.

hints.tensAndOnes: Split each number into tens and ones.
hints.jumpUp: Start at {from}. Jump to {nextTen}, then by tens and ones to {to}.
hints.jumpAdd: Start at {a}. Jump {tens} tens, then {ones} ones.
hints.jumpCrates: Add two crates: their tens first, then their ones. Do they make {target}?
hints.showFiller: Here is a load that works: {tens} sacks and {ones} boxes make {answer} kg. Press WEIGH.
hints.showCrates: These crates make {answer} kg. Press WEIGH.

a11y.addSack: Put a 10 kg sack in the freight
a11y.addBox: Put a 1 kg box in the freight
a11y.sacksAboard: Sacks in the freight: {count}. Take one off.
a11y.boxesAboard: Boxes in the freight: {count}. Take one off.
a11y.scale: Scale. The needle is between {low} and {high} kg.
a11y.readoutHidden: Press WEIGH to read the exact weight.

misconceptions.quantity.forgotTheCarry: The ones made a new ten. Is that ten in the tens?
misconceptions.quantity.smallerFromLarger: Look at the ones. Are there enough ones to take away? A ten can be broken into ten ones.
misconceptions.quantity.forgotTheBorrow: When a ten is broken into ones, there is one ten less. Count the tens again.
misconceptions.quantity.addedInsteadOfSubtracted: That is more than we started with. Is this job putting together or taking away?
misconceptions.quantity.subtractedInsteadOfAdded: Both loads go up together, so the TOTAL gets bigger. Put them together.
misconceptions.quantity.answeredWithAGiven: That number is already in the job. What does the job ask for?
misconceptions.quantity.miscountedTens: Count the tens again, then the ones.
misconceptions.quantity.stoppedAfterOneStep: That is one step done. There is one more step to go.
